parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-15 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1132.2 | 7.42 | 7.42
2 | 3621.5 | 17.67 | 25.09
3 | 4447.9 | 1.70 | 26.79
4 | 4307.5 | 0.53 | 27.32
5 | 7664.9 | 4.92 | 32.24
6 | 12762.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AKHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-15
Curve type: AKHA
Aquifer depth: 26.79–27.32 m
Recommendation: The AKHA signature indicates a thin fractured/weathered zone (Layer 4, ~0.53 m) sandwiched between higher-resistivity competent rock, which is the probable water-bearing horizon; drill with core recovery and packer testing through 26–28 m to confirm fracture yield, as the target zone is narrow and easily missed.
